subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT found in human blood?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chondrocyte**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chondrocytes** are the only cells found in healthy cartilage, a type of connective tissue. They are not found in blood.
 
• Chondrocytes produce and maintain the cartilaginous matrix, which consists mainly of collagen and proteoglycans.
 
• The primary function of chondrocytes is to maintain the extracellular matrix in cartilage, ensuring its resilience and ability to withstand compressive forces.
 
• Unlike other types of cells such as leucocytes, lymphocytes, and monocytes, chondrocytes are specialized for the formation and maintenance of cartilage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leucocyte (White Blood Cell)**

 
 
• Leucocytes are a part of the immune system and help the body fight infection and other diseases.
 
• There are several types of leucocytes, including neutrophils, lymphocytes, monocytes, eosinophils, and basophils.
 
• Leucocytes circulate in the blood and are also found in the lymphatic system.
 
 
 
• **Lymphocyte**
 
 
• Lymphocytes are a subtype of leucocytes.
 
• They play a critical role in the immune response and are primarily involved in the body's adaptive immune system.
 
• There are two main types of lymphocytes: B cells, which produce antibodies, and T cells, which destroy infected or cancerous cells.
 
 
 
• **Monocyte**
 
 
• Monocytes are a type of leucocyte that can differentiate into macrophages and dendritic cells to elicit an immune response.
 
• They are the largest type of white blood cell and have a role in both the innate and adaptive immune systems.
 
• Monocytes are known for their ability to phagocytose pathogens and present antigens to T cells.
 
 
 
• **Chondrocyte**
 
 
• Chondrocytes are specialized cells that produce and maintain the cartilaginous matrix in the body.
 
• They are found in cartilage, a type of flexible connective tissue found in various parts of the body like joints, rib cage, ear, nose, bronchial tubes, and intervertebral discs.
 
• Chondrocytes are essential for the health and maintenance of cartilage but are not found in blood.
